name: Nemesis Shawl
text:
A nemesis shawl is a white cotton capelet until its wearer dies, at which point a detailed tapestry bleeds into the fabric of the shawl and leaves a permanent depiction of their death. When you die wearing a nemesis shawl, the shroud wraps itself tightly around a portion of your remains. The shawl can then be used instead of your remains for the Resurrect ritual, Raise Dead spell, and similar effects even if your body has exploded, withered to dust, or is otherwise not intact.

Activate—Final Curse f

Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to gain the dying condition from damage dealt by a creature within 20 feet

---
Effect You use your final breath to curse your killer, causing it to become Frightened 1; this is an emotion, fear, and mental effect. Your body then explodes, dealing 13d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures in a 20-foot emanation with a DC 34 basic Reflex save save. You immediately die.
